meta.name: knowledge-agent
meta.description: Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话历史构建可查询的知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从日常对话中自动提炼知识并随时查询
copy.tagline_en: Build queryable knowledge bases from conversation history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically extract knowledge from daily conversations and query it anytime

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 能从 claude-mem 观察记录里按你指定的主题或项目挑出条目组成知识库,再把内容加载进对话;之后你可以向它提问,它会依据这些记录作答,并接住追问。
howto.when: 当你想从 claude-mem 观察记录中整理特定主题的知识库、询问过往的工作模式,或汇总某方面经验时,Claude 会触发这个技能。

say.text: 把 claude-mem 观察记录里与 hooks 相关的条目整理成知识库
say.note: 会调用 build_corpus,按主题过滤记录。
会调用 prime_corpus,把语料载入会话。

say.text: 问这个知识库:有哪五个生命周期钩子?各在何时触发?
say.note: 会调用 query_corpus,基于语料回答。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can pick relevant entries from claude-mem observation history to build knowledge bases, load one into the conversation, and answer questions from those records while retaining follow-up context.
howto.when_en: Use this when you want to create a focused knowledge base from claude-mem observations, ask about past work patterns, or compile expertise on a specific topic.

say_en.text: Turn claude-mem observations about hooks into a knowledge base.

say_en.note: Calls prime_corpus to start an AI session.

say_en.text: Ask it: what are the five lifecycle hooks and when does each fire?
say_en.note: Calls query_corpus to answer from the corpus.
